scientific_limitations: Requires independent uniform fixed-size rows, positive expected vacancy and motif count, right-motif vertices nonisolated, and non-induced incidence embeddings; a motif with isolated right vertices or conditioned total edge count is outside scope.
title: A universal vacancy–motif covariance law for fixed-row-size random incidence graphs
